backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor handling user profiles, access control, and habit tracking with creation, completion, and volume tracking structures.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping mobile sticky-column UI features to related frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style text listing summarized descriptions for many frontend files including habit UI components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark modes using OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app shell with header, auth controls, BecomingView, footer, and global query/toast setup.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component prompting unauthenticated users to sign in with Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing whether the user is signed in based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading state and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating habit data via actor calls with normalized error handling.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main habit-tracking view handling auth, loading, errors, month selection, and rendering grid and summaries.
Displays an error alert with a user-friendly message and optional retry button.
Renders skeleton placeholders for the habit grid layout while data loads.
Modal for editing a habit’s name, unit type, and volume with validation and save mutations.
Displays the habit tracking grid with day headers and rows for each habit.
Provides layout constants and helpers for consistent habit grid column sizing.
Handles adding new habits through an inline input and mutation.
Renders a single habit row with info, daily checkboxes, totals, and edit actions.
Popover showing habit actions, currently allowing editing.
Shows aggregated monthly totals for reps and time-based habits.
Renders tab controls for selecting months in 2026.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Defines 2026 month metadata and utilities for retrieving month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Defines habit completion and volume helpers, building a completion map and computing display strings and monthly totals.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Provides parsing, validation, normalization, and formatting utilities for time strings in M or M:SS formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Creates a backend actor with timeout and error normalization, supporting manual retry and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider, managing login, stored identity loading, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and a light cyber-themed design system with touch optimizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app, setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the root component.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Normalizes errors and detects stopped-canister cases, providing user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean them from the hash when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme colors, fonts, container settings, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing sticky mobile habit-column behavior, existing features, and pending feature requests.
